title: Old Fashioned Malty Russian Oats Pilaf
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring malty oats, vanilla sugar, and lardons, made plant-based friendly and perfect for meal prep in a mason jar.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the oats, vanilla sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the water, plant-based milk, and malt extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Fold in the rendered lardons and sunflower oil.
Spoon the mixture into a mason jar, leaving about 1 inch of space at the top.
Cover the jar with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the jar from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the pilaf overnight and serve chilled in the morning.
